intent_contract.text: 가로 비율 전쟁터 배경으로 프롬프트 작성하고 그려줘.

Continue the established Republic of Korea special-warfare campaign portrait with the same adult woman and camera-directed carbine aim, changing the canvas to a wide landscape ratio and replacing the training compound with a visibly war-torn battlefield.

Create a wide 16:9 landscape frame as a photorealistic Republic of Korea Armed Forces special-warfare campaign poster featuring the same unmistakably adult woman from the original reference portrait. Preserve her long oval face, eye aperture and spacing, jaw width, nose, lips, natural skin texture, and long dark wavy hair. The wide 16:9 landscape frame shows her upper body from mid-torso upward, positioned slightly right of center so the battlefield remains visible across the left and center distance. She shoulders a compact carbine and aims it straight toward the camera; both gloved hands control the weapon, the circular bore and optic form a strong foreground-to-face depth axis, and her focused face remains legible above the sight. The camera stays aligned just below her eye line. Behind her, fractured concrete barriers, churned earth, smoke columns, scattered embers, and distant firelight establish an active war-torn battlefield. Rain beads across her matte helmet, headset, uniform, plate carrier, and Republic of Korea flag patch. Cool storm daylight and restrained orange firelight bind operator and terrain into premium national-defense campaign key art: resolute, controlled, battle-ready, and decisive.

obligation.composition_instruction: Construct the frame around an intentional overhead arm pose so the face, raised-arm line, and natural underarm hollow form one readable focal plane; use crop, light, and anatomy rather than a strap or prop as a substitute for emphasis.

any_terms: 얼굴과 들어 올린 팔을 함께 강조
face and raised-arm line in one plane

render_gates.description: The overhead arm pose is clearly deliberate and structurally opens the underarm rather than exposing it incidentally.
The face, arm line, and underarm region share a coherent focal plane and visual hierarchy.
The underarm remains a primary readable region at thumbnail scale.
Shoulder, elbow, upper arm, and underarm anatomy remain plausible and unwarped.
A strap, clip, rope, or accessory is not doing the visual work that the pose, crop, and light should do.

obligation.composition_instruction: When the request context means an embodied character transition, show a readable former state, a dark current state, an unfinished on-body boundary, and one visible context-specific cause or choice. Allegiance change and a suppressed former-self remnant are optional senses, not mandatory meanings of every corruption request.

render_gates.description: A coherent former identity or allegiance remains visibly readable, not merely described by metadata.
The darkened state changes the actual character's face, body, styling, or behavior rather than appearing only as surrounding symbols.
A clear unfinished boundary between former and dark states exists on the character.
A visible cause or present-tense choice expresses the request-specific sense of corruption without forcing one allegiance or relationship story.
The corruption transition remains the first-read event rather than a generic cute or caring beat.
